title: [Tooling] Exact integer-Horner logarithm intervals with pinned equivalence tests
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This adds an opt-in exact logarithm kernel using homogeneous integer Horner evaluation. It returns **the same lower and upper rational fractions** as the retained 80-term `log_unit`: no series term, remainder, precision, rounding, surcharge or admission decision changes.

The package replaces repeated Fraction powers/additions with 79 integer Horner updates. `PROOF.md` gives the algebraic identity and invariant for every exact rational input in [1,2]; finite tests corroborate the implementation. The pinned reference, fixtures, original code and proof are byte-identical to the user's ChatGPT-produced ZIP.

**No production activation or new κ.** All additions are under `research/exact-log-horner/`. Existing engines, supplier inputs, `upstream/` and the selected certificate stay unchanged. Adopting this kernel in a production caller remains a separate integration with affected source-pin updates and full replay.

Fresh macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.8 measurements, seven alternating-order repetitions on identical inputs:

| Workload | Reference median | Horner median | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Logarithm microbatch, 20 × 9 arguments | 51.424 ms | 4.840 ms | 10.62× |
| Native-complex accepted/adjacent endpoint pair | 14.881 ms | 6.133 ms | 2.43× |
| Three charged pairs, six endpoints total | 43.783 ms | 19.167 ms | 2.28× |

These are arithmetic workloads, not full frontier replay or multiplication runtime. The original Linux evidence is retained separately; fresh `codex-` receipts identify this submission replay. Exact outputs are compared after every timed pair; no input-dependent result cache is used.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/exact-log-horner/verify.py --benchmark
python3 -I -O -B research/exact-log-horner/verify.py
python3 -B research/exact-log-horner/test_package.py
```

Python 3.10+ standard library only. Expected markers: `PASS_EXACT_LOG_HORNER` and `PASS_PACKAGE_CONTROLS`.

Passed freshly from a full checkout at exact base `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`:

- 5,872 exact logarithm comparisons, six charged accept/adjacent-reject moment endpoints and five pricing controls per engine.
- Eight numerically detected implementation mutations, 24 inherited domain rejections, three non-exact-input rejections, and two exact integer endpoints.
- Eight package/source corruption controls, including optimized Python and paths with spaces.
- Normal and optimized results match the original handoff fingerprint `c926bc76b11c982a477174b4c09ea0be2b4c549ae4dcd8215d7ac19deb91202a`.
- All seven upstream path identities and extracted profile/endpoint fields match the complete repository. Reference Git blob: `14a90fa0e788217856f070382c9e61bd7c603c61`.
- Final manifest/reference checks and staged whitespace check pass.

No full supplier rebuild, repository-wide suite, 47-inequality assembly, second moment engine, Lean or remote CI pass is claimed. Physical/count/compiler/hosting/precision/tape/analytic obligations remain inherited.

The original seed-89 claim is preserved. Final overlap checks include open metadata through #665 and a `log_unit` PR search with zero results. #662's Clifford helper acceleration concerns a different workload; #585/#605's Lean logarithm/moment work is credited. No pinned coordination issue exists, so coordination and result are recorded locally.

Prepared at Tuomo Kiiskinen's request with substantial OpenAI ChatGPT assistance; subsequent source review, full-checkout replay and PR preparation used OpenAI Codex. `NOTICE.md` retains the original engine and selected-supplier contributors' attribution. Apache-2.0.
